title: FaultDx DEKG Full-Document and Evidence-Residual Ingestion Contract
description: Defines the governed DEKGEvidenceRecord envelope. DEKG normally receives the complete governed serving-safe document. Evidence-residual mode is used only when anchored tabular segments from that document are selected for TPDX; those table segments are partitioned out and the remaining document content enters DEKG.

schema_relationship.note: DEKGEvidenceRecord is a governed transfer object. Any DEKG graph/index representation is a downstream derivative that must retain evidence_id.

routing_order: Register, parse, mask, and validate the governed source document as one mother-document version.
Decide whether any anchored table segment is selected for TPDX; extraction success alone is not a selection decision.
If no table is selected, emit all eligible serving-safe document content in full_document mode.
If tables are selected, emit those anchored tables to the TPDX candidate/review path first and record their consumption state.
Then emit only the remaining eligible content in evidence_residual mode with the same mother-document version and co-source group.

full_document.applicability: Default. Use when no tabular segment from the document is selected for TPDX.
full_document.scope: All eligible serving-safe text, table, and VLM-derived text records from the governed document.

evidence_residual.applicability: Use only when one or more anchored tabular segments from the same mother document are selected for TPDX.
evidence_residual.scope: Eligible serving-safe document content remaining after the selected table anchors are partitioned out.
evidence_residual.rule: Selected TPDX table segments must not be emitted again as DEKG evidence records. The remaining content retains the same mother-document version and co-source group.

identity_rules.evidence_id: DEK_ plus SHA-256 of the canonical JSON tuple [dekg_evidence_identity_v1, ingestion_mode, source_id, source_version, doc_id, block_id, anchor, content_kind, chunk ordinal]. It is the stable handoff identity used by downstream derivatives.
identity_rules.doc_id: Stable mother-document identity within one source_id and source_version; preserve across deterministic rebuilds of unchanged source content.
identity_rules.block_id: Stable source-structure anchor within one doc_id; do not derive identity from display text alone.
identity_rules.chunk_id: Deterministic from contract version, doc_id, block_id, chunking_rule_version, and chunk ordinal.
identity_rules.collision_behavior: Reject duplicate evidence_id or composite identity source_id/source_version/doc_id/block_id/chunk_id unless byte-equivalent after canonical serialization.
identity_rules.alias_behavior: Source aliases may aid lookup but never replace source_id or change record identity.

missingness_rules.nullable_fields: Preserve explicit null when the source does not provide the value.
missingness_rules.required_anchor: Reject the record when no stable source anchor can be produced.
missingness_rules.no_inference: Do not invent document structure, diagnosis, cause, action, or topology scope to complete a record.

mode_rules.none: Required for full_document. decision_id and tpdx_consumption_state are null; extraction/content-kind/excluded-anchor arrays are empty.
mode_rules.partitioned_table_extraction: Required for evidence_residual. decision_id, table-only extraction refs, consumption state, and excluded table anchors are present and non-empty.

co_source.full_document_rule: group_id may be null and TPDX refs are empty when no content from the document is selected for TPDX.
co_source.evidence_residual_rule: group_id and TPDX extraction refs are required and match the partition decision.
co_source.rule: TPDX table output and DEKG residual from one mother document are co-source outputs and cannot count as independent corroboration.

support_artifacts.note: Graph/index support shapes remain outside this ingestion contract and outside TPDX. They cannot replace DEKGEvidenceRecord as the governed lineage anchor.

changed: DEKG is named explicitly as the knowledge asset.
Full-document ingestion is the default mode.
Evidence-residual mode is conditional on anchored table extraction for TPDX.
TPDX consumption state, excluded table anchors, and co-source rules are explicit.
DEKGEvidenceRecord replaces DocumentAsset as the governed handoff object and is not a graph node.
Path-shaped allowed_source_ids are replaced by governed source and release identifiers.
